About us

The thriving port city of Timaru is surrounded by picturesque bustling towns, lush pasture, rolling downlands, green hills and clean rivers lie in the lee of New Zealand's magnificent Southern Alps in the west. More than 42,000 residents enjoy life in Timaru District. Moderately-priced real estate, good medical services, excellent educational facilities, an abundance of sporting and recreational facilities and a friendly community all contribute to make Timaru District a welcoming and attractive destination. Enterprising businesses keep the workforce stable.

    There's only a week and a half until nominations close and, aside from Pleasant Point - Temuka Ward, we still don't have enough candidates to fill all our seats let alone have an election! At the moment we don't have any nominations for: - Mayor - Geraldine Ward - Geraldine Community Board - Geraldine Licensing Trust And we don't have enough nominations yet for: - Timaru Ward - Pleasant Point Community Board - Temuka Community Board If you're thinking of standing for council this year, time's running out to get your nomination in. It's a really straightforward process, all the information you need to do it is at https://lnkd.in/gtDbkK_w You can do it by email or drop in and ask for one of our elections staff at the main council building. Don't leave it till the last minute, as it needs to be approved by the electoral officer before noon on Friday 1 August! You can see who has put their name in the hat so far at: https://lnkd.in/gVnhhqVX
